remarks: A rare opportunity to own a condo featuring 2 Bed, 2 Full Baths, 10+ ft ceiling with loft in downtown South Norwalk. Easy access to I-95, SONO Collection Mall , businesses, restaurants, bars, beaches, meeting spaces, parks, dog park, golf, boating, health & fitness facilities, festivals, sunrises and sunsets. In the heart of South Norwalk, this makes the perfect location whether you are commuting, working, this is a charming retreat to be your home. Washer & dryer in unit with walk-in pantry. Plenty of parking options for monthly passes. 360 virtual tour available. schedule a tour today.
